scope: Supplement to139-row source checklist; scoped cases only, no full-row or visual parity claim
last_observed_full_ui_race: 2026-10-25T04:57:07Z: PASS,5.537s; later integration rerun in progress

cases.title: Window creation and parked lifetime
steps: Start with empty isolated preferences.
Inspect native window minimum and initial maximize; close/reopen on macOS while a fake Pi session streams.
cases.expected: Source minimum 960×640; restore85% display width and90%height capped1440×920; one parked controller/process survives close.
cases.remaining: Pure restore bounds and native traffic-light clearance pass. Actual maximize/center/close/reopen/16ms-active heartbeat across all OS remains unexecuted.

cases.title: Geometry, fractional scaling and restored dimensions
steps: Drag sidebar/review/explorer/terminal widths; relaunch.
Repeat font12/14/18 and density80/100/120.
cases.expected: Logical rectangles stay stable under device scale; source clamps and persisted layout survive relaunch.
cases.remaining: DIP composer and modal bounds pass, including800×560 stress below source minimum. Full panel drag/relaunch/font-density matrix and matched pixels remain open.

cases.title: Filtered command/model keyboard selection
steps: Open palette, move down six entries, filter to one and press Enter.
Filter to zero then restore and press Enter.
Open prompt from palette; Escape back to composer.
cases.expected: Filtered selection resets/clamps; zero results do not submit; stable modal keys restore focus.
cases.remaining: These exact native CPU flows pass, not every command/context or OS accelerator.

cases.title: Native menu and modal precedence
steps: Open confirm, prompt, custom terminal, secret, image, model or palette.
Dispatch New task/Settings/Terminal through native menu.
For custom UI press Escape, then explicit Cancel.
cases.expected: No action mutates behind modal. Custom Escape sends ESC to Pi rather than dismissing; explicit Cancel cancels.
cases.remaining: Live custom test requires ORBIT_TERMINAL_TEST and pinned Ghostty; it was run previously. Ordinary default suite skips opt-in test. OS-native menu entry/accelerator dispatch remains separate.

cases.title: Session switch, workspace routing and drafts
steps: Enter a draft with attachments, switch to another saved task then back.
Switch to a task in another repository.
Observe Git/Files/Worktrees/terminal new-tab directory without starting an extra session.
cases.expected: Per-session draft is retained; domain actions target selected repository; loading sessions do not overwrite new active choice.
cases.remaining: Draft/inactive file generation tests pass. Whole native controller repository-switch interaction with fake Pi and all domain mutations still needs a dedicated end-to-end fixture.

cases.title: Sidebar sessions and workspace management
steps: Use numbered/next/previous session commands.
Rename, pin, archive, restore, clone and recoverably delete.
Change workspace sort/group/mark/icon and refresh fan-out.
cases.expected: Source ordering, active visibility, collapse persistence, all metadata operations and contextual menu semantics match.
cases.remaining: Backend session operations exist, but host-level interaction/restart checks are incomplete. Source workspace marks/icons, all sorting modes and sticky/active reveal presentation are not fully reconstructed.

cases.title: Multiline and Chinese composition
steps: Type line one, Shift+Enter, line two.
Start IME composition; Enter commits composition only.
Commit Chinese text then Enter.
cases.expected: No prompt during composition; native text editing and multiline text remain intact.
cases.remaining: Headless composition event and multiline submission pass. Real Chinese/Japanese/Korean OS IME candidates, clipboard and accessibility remain unexecuted.

cases.title: Delivery policy, repeated send and rejected retry
steps: Set follow_up; Alt+Enter sends steer.
Press Enter again with empty input.
Reject Submit during maintenance/disconnect, then retry.
cases.expected: One action per accepted nonempty submission; rejected draft remains; alternate mode is exact opposite.
cases.remaining: Exact tested sends/rejection pass. Source individual queue editing/removal and one/all queued delivery controls are incomplete in host UI.

cases.title: Slash and file-mention autocomplete
steps: Type / then filter a command.
Type @ then select a nested file by keyboard.
Escape cancels; accepting replaces only trigger range.
cases.expected: Source composer_ops autocomplete ordering, keyboard ownership and trigger replacement.
cases.remaining: Host currently has no source-equivalent slash/file-mention popup. Plain text commands are forwarded but are not autocomplete parity.

cases.title: Attachments, drag/paste and partial failure
steps: Select multiple valid images plus unreadable/oversized files.
Paste text and image; drag files.
Remove one; switch tasks; send and inspect RPC image bytes.
cases.expected: Bounded read/compression, actual per-file errors, no lost draft, source paste priority and max-count behavior.
cases.remaining: Attachment Prepare and transport domain tests exist; host native add/drop/clipboard/partial-failure end-to-end tests and source text-file mention semantics remain open.

cases.title: Model/thinking/favorites
steps: Filter model picker to one/zero and recover.
Switch provider and select thinking level.
Favorite model, enable favorites-only and relaunch.
cases.expected: Actual catalog/capabilities; no unsupported thinking choice; favorites/recent persistence and source model cards.
cases.remaining: Keyboard picker works. Source favorites-only/provider filter/detail catalog page remains incomplete; existing simple model list is not full P08.

cases.title: Long streamed transcript reading position
steps: Render120 variable-height messages.
Scroll up in30-DIP steps, append/grow streamed assistant message.
Jump to latest, grow again.
cases.expected: Stable keys retain reader position; follow resumes only at end; variable-height rows do not jump to bottom unexpectedly.
cases.remaining: Native CPU follow/read-position test passes. Source navigation rail and full turn grouping remain missing; GPU long-session/performance acceptance is open.

cases.title: Rich Markdown and code
steps: Render alerts, tables, lists, fenced code, links, images and malformed streamed fences.
Resize with code wrapping.
Change light/dark theme.
cases.expected: Source semantic Markdown and color-only syntax with stable font metrics.
cases.remaining: GFM alert/geometry sample passes; highlight tokenizer has1204 source-oracle cases. Whole source markdown corpus, per-message media/actions and exact spacing remain unverified.

cases.title: Transcript selection, tools and turn summaries
steps: Select across multiple Markdown blocks/messages.
Open Bash/read/edit/write/search tool cards and errors.
Inspect finished turn duration/tokens/cost.
cases.expected: Source structured tool presentation, cross-block selection, context menu and turn metrics.
cases.remaining: Host has selectable individual text/Markdown, generic collapsible tool output and copy response. Source typed tool cards, full cross-message selection/context menu and detailed turn summaries are incomplete.

cases.title: Transcript search
steps: Search text present in assistant and tool output.
Next/previous wraps; clear/close then search again.
Stream another matching row while search is active.
cases.expected: Find stays distinct from command palette; active hit scroll and highlight/count are correct.
cases.remaining: Search implementation exists, but dedicated interaction test and source highlight/active-hit keyboard behavior are not yet verified.

cases.title: Stop/retry/compact and context freshness
steps: Stop active run; retry a failed run.
Compact successfully and inspect missing context before refreshed stats.
Repeat failed/aborted compaction.
cases.expected: No cumulative-total substitute for context; missing is unknown, not0%; successful compaction invalidates old context.
cases.remaining: Pure adapters and agent compaction reducer tests pass. Full native retry/compaction indicators and every button/state transition remain open.

cases.title: Extension special-purpose surfaces
steps: Exercise select/confirm/input/editor and custom ANSI render.
Exercise Allow once/Always/Deny guard, Plan/Build/Ask and multi-question ask_user_question.
Set/replace/clear widgets and editor text.
cases.expected: Exact IDs/response types, scoped keys, no fake unsupported capability and source specialized panels.
cases.remaining: General modal and ANSI custom bridge exist. Structured questionnaire, specialized inline approval/replay, widget placement and unavailable workflow/access presentation are not fully wired. No full extension parity claim.

cases.title: Settings categories, search and scroll
steps: Visit all14 source sections.
Scroll a long page, switch away for8 frames, return.
Search a row label/synonym and activate result.
cases.expected: Source section order; retained per-page scroll; search navigates exact row with source keyboard behavior.
cases.remaining: 14 sections and retained native scroll pass; fixed missing FillHeight that previously prevented long pages scrolling. Exact-row/synonym search is missing; current category-only search fails source P01.

cases.title: Runtime diagnostics and agent settings
steps: Inspect active/parked PID/executable/uptime/stdout/stderr.
Start/Stop/Restart; dependency install failure/cancel.
Change defaults, auto-retry/compaction/title model; restart/resume.
cases.expected: Only real process fields, safe busy gates and source fresh-session-only defaults.
cases.remaining: Host lacks actual PID/uptime/stderr/process-row adapter and complete auto-retry/follow-up/title-model controls. Native dependency/install helpers exist; action/OS integration needs execution. Do not fabricate metrics.

cases.title: Provider catalog, typed editor and credentials
steps: Inspect catalog including fallback diagnostic and OAuth-only provider.
Save invalid custom provider; correct it and save into temporary home.
Force disk failure; cancel masked key dialog; resize800×560.
cases.expected: Capability-specific controls, validated fields, no painted key, failed save keeps draft, existing key preserved when blank.
cases.remaining: These native/disk fixtures pass. Full provider card geometry, source account detail/quota embed and real credential flows remain unverified.

Use active-provider5h/peak/balance/global fallbacks and failed reports.
Inspect refresh/reset and hidden-provider preferences.
cases.expected: No stale sign-in overwrites later state; quota priority/unknown handling source-equivalent.
cases.remaining: Pure quota rules pass; live OAuth, full quota popup grouping/hidden-provider/MCP tabs and OS browser-return lifecycle remain unverified or incomplete.

cases.title: Skills and plugin resources
steps: Search/select Skills, inspect frontmatter-stripped detail, enable/disable/delete with cancellation.
Install by global/project scope; double-click operation, cancel, change workspace while pending.
Check/skip/clear/update actual package offers.
cases.expected: Source master/detail, scope/mutation serialization, stale completion rejection and precise persistence.
cases.remaining: Dedicated resourceui replaces generic host implementation and is mounted. Worker source checklist/native/race tests are in progress; do not claim completed acceptance until handoff.

cases.title: Typed MCP lifecycle
steps: Create/edit stdio andHTTP servers acrossglobal/project scope.
Validate timeout, exposure and secret references; cancel OAuth/remove.
Apply while task busy; verify deferred session-preserving reload.
cases.expected: Source typed fields, redacted status, scope-aware metadata/secrets and truthful requested-vs-applied state.

cases.title: Appearance, localization and help
steps: Change every theme/font/density/motion choice and relaunch.
Visit all sections in each of10 locales.
Configure animated/photo backdrop and inspect keyboard reference.
cases.expected: Source palette/tokens and persistent preferences, complete localization and backdrop.
cases.remaining: 10 palettes and55 binding parsing pass; many host labels remain English, backdrop integration is pending, and font/density/motion/OS contrast visual matrix remains open.

cases.title: Actual usage accounting and unavailable data
steps: Scan explicit temporary Pi JSONL fixtures, including unbilled provider failures, pending tool calls and compaction.
Filter model/provider and request-only flags.
Compare cost coverage and absent duration/cache against source.
cases.expected: No fabricatedzero metrics, no pending-tool failure, real call-start attribution and source turn semantics.
cases.remaining: Focused domain/projection cases pass; this does not close the complete analytics corpus or all UI displays.

cases.title: Usage Simple/Details loading/error/empty
steps: Render loading then actual data; change mode.
Fail refresh after prior good data; render only unbilled errors.
Inspect fixed-date labelled fixture screenshots.
cases.expected: Source modes and honest pending/partial/error/empty states, no invented live metrics.
cases.remaining: Native cards/heatmap/chart/breakdowns/session/failure rows render. Source comparison deltas, signals, detailed cache/latency panels and exact layout remain missing; screenshots are fixtures, not Rust comparisons.

cases.title: Date and scoped drill-down
steps: Select multiple workspaces/providers/models.
Select calendar day outside prior date range; bucket/session drill-down; clear focus.
Use reversed custom dates; choose range with a quiet middle day.
cases.expected: Calendar independent of date filter, valid scope remains, date normalization and contiguous zero-activity axis.
cases.remaining: Multi-select menus, scope fields, calendar normalization and contiguous4k guarded buckets implemented. Searchable native multi-select popup and disambiguating identical model IDs acrossproviders remain incomplete.

cases.title: Tables, detail dialogs and export
steps: Sort equal-metric rows both ways; paginate; open source session.
Open failure detail; Escape and native menu guard.
Choose CSV/JSON, cancel native Save, then export to disposablefile.
cases.expected: Stable ties, no phantom detail metrics, actual session path, source export schema and unknown fields preserved.
cases.remaining: Stable sorting/modal/prefs cases pass; JSON/CSV backend implemented and host chooser wired. Independent table states, column visibility/resize/context menus and actual native Save interaction remain open.

cases.title: Maintenance interrupts and retention

Run retention on temporary sessions, including active/parked ones.
Cancel temp cleanup/install confirmations and inspect errors.
cases.expected: No prompt loss/new process during exclusive update; live sessions protected; explicit cleanup and honest progress.
cases.remaining: Guard and temporary retention tests pass. Whole native update/install/temp dialogs and real OS notification lifecycle remain platform acceptance gates.
